failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM mobility remaining above 3.0%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 7 days despite a week-on-week drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, even if PARKS mobility remains above -15.0%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days, despite both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT increasing by more than 1.0 percentage point week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days, even if PARKS drops significantly and RESIDENTIAL rises.
